title: Zenodo upload: Sector 114 pre-registration
intro: Reserved DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23290795. Fill the Zenodo form top to bottom; every box has a Copy button.

fields.label: Title
fields.value: Pre-registered prediction: TESS Sector 114 transits of the 5.45-day candidate on TOI-913 (TIC 407126408)

fields.label: Author: affiliation
fields.note: Type it, then choose 'Create'. Identifiers: paste your ORCID iD. Role: leave blank.

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Predicted mid-transit times, expected depth and frozen pass/fail criteria for the 5.45-day TOI-913 candidate in TESS Sector 114 (planned 2027 Feb 13 – Mar 14), registered before the data exist. The result will be published as a new version of this record whatever it is.

fields.label: License
fields.note: Search 'CC BY 4.0' in the license picker.

fields.note: Then: pre-registration · exoplanets · transit photometry · TOI-913 · TIC 407126408
